entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: individual portrait for Rianna Wyrm's mount Goldlöckchen. Vertical 2:3 composition. A beautiful noble WHITE Goldmähne MARE, with a spectacular VOLUMINOUS CURLY GOLDEN mane, golden flowing tail, soft grey muzzle, lively gentle dark eyes. Real horse proportions; exactly four legs, four hooves, two ears. Fully visible from ears to hooves with comfortable margin, calm three-quarter standing pose beside a quiet medieval castle paddock. Her bridle and saddle are fine BLACK LEATHER with small GOLD fittings, rich golden-YELLOW saddlecloth bearing the BLACK WINGED DRAGON of House Wyrm, accurately based on the heraldic reference. The horse reference establishes the white body and golden mane ONLY; do NOT copy its blue armor, rider, watercolor style or tournament scene. The emblem reference establishes ONLY house colors and dragon design. NO rider, no other animals, no text or frames. Warm soft daylight, uncluttered grassy courtyard and a little old stone wall. Clean Tales of Xillia/Frieren anime lineart and cel shading, simple painted anime textures, no photorealism or parchment.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: individual portrait for Lefraye Gafyr's mare THALENA. Vertical 2:3. A Farnschritt mare, a Tirashan x Rhyfel cross: medium-to-large practical riding horse with a compact athletic trunk, strong sure-footed legs, sturdy hooves and an elegant but robust head; less massive than a pure heavy warhorse. Rich DARK BAY coat, BLACK mane and tail, a SMALL WHITE STAR on forehead, dark lower legs, subtle short fetlock hair. Exactly four legs and four hooves, two ears, no antlers. Whole horse visible ears to hooves with margin, calm attentive three-quarter standing pose on a simple fern-lined woodland path. Practical dark leather saddle and bridle with modest brass fittings, BLACK saddlecloth with GOLD trim and the paired confronting GOLD GOATS of House Gafyr, based on the heraldic reference. First two references establish the parental body traits ONLY; NO riders, antlers, armor, banners or watercolor rendering. Third reference establishes Gafyr insignia and colors only. NO people or extra animals, no writing, no frames. Quiet filtered daylight, sparse woodland background. Clean Tales of Xillia/Frieren anime art, clear lineart and cel shading, simplified anime textures, no photorealism.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: individual companion portrait of SIR FRESSBERT, Rianna Wyrm's beloved lazy male housecat. Vertical 2:3. A comfortably well-fed adult Cenyric tomcat, warm ORANGE GINGER TABBY fur, CREAM muzzle and chest, round soft cheeks, pink nose, amber-green eyes half shut with a majestically lazy expression. Natural healthy stocky cat, short-to-medium fur; exactly four paws, two ears, one tail. Reclining and loafing on a simple golden-yellow cushion beside a sunny stone castle window, all of the cat and curled tail visible. The humor is entirely in his smug sleepy demeanor; NO human clothes, crown, money, jewels or anthropomorphic hands. A modest black border on the cushion echoes House Wyrm's gold-and-black colors. Warm afternoon light, uncluttered background with just stone and a hint of a green garden outside. Clear Tales of Xillia/Frieren anime lineart, clean cel shading, soft simple anime textures, no realistic fur rendering, no watercolor, no text or frames.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: individual companion portrait of AGRAVAINE, called VAIN, Lefraye Gafyr's Mwyalchen thrush. Vertical 2:3. ONE small natural THRUSH / blackbird-like songbird, NOT a raven and NOT a bird of prey. Sleek charcoal-BLACK plumage with soft slate-grey feather highlights, slender DARK beak, a subtle warm AMBER eye ring, fine dark legs and delicate songbird feet. Natural little thrush proportions, compact rounded torso, neat short wings folded, modest long tail, alert expressive eye. Perched in three-quarter view on a slender branch at the edge of a peaceful leafy woodland near a medieval estate. Entire bird, tail and both feet visible with room around the silhouette. The House Mwyalchen heraldic reference establishes the black thrush motif ONLY; do NOT reproduce the round emblem, heraldic ornaments, fire, gold decorations or frame. No jewelry, no harness, no written labels, no other birds or people. Soft morning light, few leaves, uncluttered green background. Clean Tales of Xillia/Frieren anime lineart and cel shading with simplified feather shapes, no photorealism or watercolor.

Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Create ONE new vertical 2:3 biography portrait of the exact SAME adult 19-year-old Rianna Wyrm from reference 1. Head-to-below-knees three-quarter portrait in a quiet sunlit castle gallery, poised proud stance, one empty bare hand lightly gathering the skirt and the other resting at her waist, knowing self-satisfied smile, natural believable hands with exactly five fingers each. NO armor, weapons, companions, tiara, modern fashion or extra figures. Clean anime lineart and cel shading matching her supplied original and Tales of Xillia/Frieren; warm soft daylight, simple stone arch background. No text or frame.
